what_it_does: IBM's Power11 is the next generation of the POWER processor family, designed for high-performance server and data center workloads. The processor improves on its predecessors with a stronger single-core engine (better performance on code that runs on one core), more efficient power consumption, and significantly higher memory bandwidth—the pipeline that feeds data from memory into the compute cores. These improvements target both traditional server work and high-performance computing (HPC) simulations used in science and engineering.
